form.label: ATLAS Matrix
form.description: This dashboard provides an overview of triggered tactics and techniques based on enabled correlation rules with related MITRE ATLAS annotations.

search.query: | makeresults | eval mitre_use_es=`mitre_use_es` | eval results=if(mitre_use_es=="1",1,null()) | table results
| rest /services/data/lookup-table-files splunk_server=local | search title="atlas_user_rule_compliance_lookup.csv" | stats count | eval setup_done=if(count>0,"yes","no")

`atlas_rules` | fields rule_name, urgency, score, technique_id, technique_name, tactic_id, tactic_name | search $urgency_field$ | stats count as triggered_count list(rule_name) as rule_name_list, max(score) as max_score by technique_id | eval rule_name_list=mvjoin(mvdedup(rule_name_list),";")

| inputlookup $tok_display_option$ | rename AML.TA0002 as TA0002, AML.TA0003 as TA0003, AML.TA0004 as TA0004, AML.TA0000 as TA0000, AML.TA0005 as TA0005, AML.TA0006 as TA0006, AML.TA0012 as TA0012, AML.TA0007 as TA0007, AML.TA0013 as TA0013, AML.TA0008 as TA0008, AML.TA0015 as TA0015, AML.TA0009 as TA0009, AML.TA0004 as TA0004, AML.TA0014 as TA0014, AML.TA0010 as TA0010, AML.TA0011 as TA0011 | foreach TA00* [| lookup atlas_tt_lookup technique_id as <<FIELD>> OUTPUT technique_name as <<FIELD>>_technique_name | eval <<FIELD>>_technique_name=mvindex(<<FIELD>>_technique_name,0)]

| join type=left [| loadjob $subsearch_id$ | rename technique_id as TA0002, triggered_count as TA0002_attack_count, rule_name_list as TA0002_rule_name_list, max_score as TA0002_max_score ] | fillnull value="NULL" TA0002,TA0002_rule_name_list,TA0002_technique_name | fillnull value=0 TA0002_attack_count,TA0002_max_score | eval TA0002=TA0002."|".TA0002_technique_name."|".TA0002_attack_count."|".TA0002_rule_name_list."|".TA0002_max_score
